layout_and_sections.1_header: Sticky navbar with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md, OW logo mark, anchors (#catalogue, #comparatif, #roi, #processus, #europe, #faq), contact CTA and admin portal link
layout_and_sections.2_hero_section: Masked line-by-line reveal heading, live quote trigger, stats counter preview (130 pcs/h, 0% rebut), interactive 3D machine preview node
layout_and_sections.3_marquee_ribbon: Slow editorial marquee celebrating OW Auto Grinding x Weijing partnership, distribution Europe, ISO precision, 500+ installations
layout_and_sections.4_catalogue_section: Interactive Fiche Produit tabs for GV 120, GV 130, GV 230 (Featured), GV 270, and GV 2100 with technical blueprint specs & pallet options
layout_and_sections.5_differentiators_bento: 6 technical pillars (Direct drive spindle, Diamond discs, Laser 3D scanning, <15min quick fixture setup, Pre-machining capability, Offline programming)
layout_and_sections.6_comparison_table: Interactive tri-column comparative matrix: CNC OW Auto Grinding vs Cellule Robotisée vs Ébavurage Manuel
layout_and_sections.7_roi_calculator: Interactive ROI & productivity slider calculator computing annual Euro savings, payback period (months), and hourly gain
layout_and_sections.8_five_step_process: Horizontal/vertical timeline showing 1. Diagnostic pièce, 2. Test sur échantillon, 3. Configuration machine, 4. Livestock & Installation, 5. Support & Maintenance
layout_and_sections.9_europe_coverage: Interactive map visual showcasing European intervention hubs (France, Allemagne, Italie, Benelux, Espagne)
layout_and_sections.10_faq_accordion: Shadcn accordion answering top 6 technical & commercial questions
layout_and_sections.11_quote_form_modal: Comprehensive quote request form capturing part material, annual volume, drawing upload, contact details
layout_and_sections.12_legal_modal: Mentions Légales and Politique de Confidentialité structured popups/sections
layout_and_sections.13_admin_dashboard: Protected admin portal at /admin with passcode login, viewing live submitted quotes, status updates (Nouveau, En étude, Devis envoyé, Gagné), filter & export

instructions_to_main_agent.language: French exclusively across all user-facing content.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, sliders, accordions, modals, admin table rows) MUST carry explicit data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme: Light & Technical theme with crisp borders (border-slate-200), high-density data cards, and overkkast gold accent highlights.
instructions_to_main_agent.smooth_scroll: Ensure Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion reveals are seamlessly integrated.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_access: Include a discrete 'Accès Admin' link in footer or header navigating to /admin for viewing quote requests.
